note: S8A-04 CP1 — synthetic Shared World conversations for the real DeepSeek Flash reading (Product Owner D5, 2026-10-24). Every person, name and event is invented. The criteria are what a blind rater checks; they are never sent to the model.

scenarios.tests: two people who share a name
messages: أنا رأيي نسافر إسكندرية أول أسبوع في أغسطس، البحر هناك أحلى وقت
أنا مش موافق خالص، الأسعار نار والأحسن نوفر الفلوس للعربية
طب يا جماعة إحنا محتاجين نقرر، الحجز بيخلص آخر الشهر
خلاص لو المشكلة الفلوس أنا ممكن أدفع جزء أكبر
برضه لأ، أنا مش هسافر السنة دي
criteria: C1 Two people named Mohamed are never merged: no meaning presents one Mohamed as holding both positions, as having changed his mind, or as agreeing with himself.
C2 A meaning about the trip disagreement keeps the two positions apart (one wants the trip and offers to pay more; the other refuses and wants to save) and cites contributions of both.
C3 Sources: every meaning's sourceRefs are contributions that actually say what the meaning says.

scenarios.tests: one person speaking about another participant
messages: أحمد دايمًا بيتأخر على أي ميعاد بنحدده
أنا اتأخرت مرة واحدة الشهر ده بس، وكانت بسبب الشغل
مرة واحدة؟ لأ يا أحمد، المرة اللي فاتت كمان استنيناك ساعة
ماشي، أنا هحاول أبقى أدق في المواعيد
criteria: C1 That Ahmed is always late stays Mona's view or complaint; no meaning states as fact that Ahmed is unreliable, irresponsible or always late.
C2 Ahmed's own position is understood as his: he disputes the frequency (once, because of work) and/or commits to be more punctual.
C3 Sources: a meaning about the dispute cites contributions of both Mona and Ahmed; no meaning cites a contribution that does not say it.

scenarios.tests: a reported statement, an opinion and a fact
messages: كريم قالي امبارح إنه مش هيقدر ييجي فرح ليلى
غريبة، هو كان مأكد إنه جاي
أنا شايفة إن الفرح لازم يتأجل لو العيلة كلها مش هتحضر
على فكرة الفرح يوم ١٥ في القاعة اللي في المعادي
criteria: C1 Karim (absent) not coming is a report: it is attributed to Karim as told by Sara, or marked as unconfirmed; it is never Sara's own position, and never a settled fact.
C2 Postponing the wedding is Nour's opinion (conditional), never a group decision or a fact.
C3 The date and the venue, if mentioned, are kept as stated information; sources are the contributions that say each thing.

scenarios.tests: a position taken back and an agreement that replaces it
messages: أنا شايف إننا نأجل إطلاق المشروع لحد السنة الجاية
عندكم حق، أنا رجعت في كلامي. خلينا نطلق الشهر الجاي قبل المعرض
تمام، يبقى متفقين على الشهر الجاي
criteria: C1 The current shared position is launching next month, before the exhibition, agreed by the group.
C2 Yasser's postponement is never presented as his current position or as an open option he still holds; if mentioned, it is as withdrawn.
C3 Sources: the agreement cites at least the withdrawal/proposal and the agreement contributions.

scenarios.tests: a person writing another person's name and words inside their own message
messages: إيه رأيكم نبيع العربية القديمة ونجيب واحدة أصغر؟
أنا ما قلتش كده خالص يا رامي، أنا ضد البيع دلوقتي
بهزر معاكي 😄 بس بصراحة أنا مع هاني
criteria: C1 Nadia's position is against selling now; no meaning says or implies that Nadia agreed to sell.
C2 The line «نادية: أنا موافقة …» is Rami's (a joke), never Nadia's words or position.
C3 Hany proposes selling and Rami supports him; sources match who said what.

scenarios.tests: no new meaning: the World already holds it and the rest is small talk
messages: قررنا نروح شرم الشيخ أول أكتوبر

existing.meaning: رحلة شرم الشيخ أول أكتوبر والفندق اتحجز

criteria: C1 No new place: an empty list, or nothing that only restates the existing meaning or turns the small talk into a meaning.
C2 Nothing is invented (no new plan, decision or feeling that nobody stated).
